pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor"), repeat_donors AS (SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donations WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM donor_counts WHERE donation_count > 1) GROUP BY "Donor"), repeat_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS repeat_amount, COUNT(*) AS repeat_count FROM repeat_donors), total AS (SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donations) SELECT (r.repeat_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(t.total_amount, 0), 0)) AS percent_of_total, r.repeat_count FROM repeat_total AS r CROSS JOIN total AS t

CURRENT QUESTION:
what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_donors AS (
  SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM donations
  WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM donor_counts WHERE donation_count > 1)
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS repeat_amount, COUNT(*) AS repeat_count
  FROM repeat_donors
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM donations
)
SELECT 
  (r.repeat_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_amount, 0)) AS percent_of_total,
  r.repeat_count
FROM repeat_total r, total t;
